useCase.query: Following the standards of a fresh-grocery e-commerce app visual designer, design a set of homepage king-kong category icons covering 12 fresh ingredient categories — rice, bread, milk, eggs, meat, vegetables, apples, seafood, nuts, cooking oil, soy sauce and cake. Unified white background rounded-corner cards, 3D skeuomorphic texture, clean and refined, suited for homepage category navigation.
